description: This file contains Cypress test utility functions and constants for testing dashboard filters, charts, and interactions in the Superset frontend. It includes predefined chart specifications, filter options, intercept functions for API calls, and helper functions for interacting with native filters and dashboard tabs.

methods.name: interceptGet
methods.description: Intercepts GET requests to dashboard API endpoints for testing.

methods.name: interceptFiltering
methods.description: Intercepts filtering API requests for dashboard search queries.

methods.name: interceptBulkDelete
methods.description: Intercepts bulk delete requests for dashboards.

methods.name: interceptDelete
methods.description: Intercepts delete requests for individual dashboards.

methods.name: interceptUpdate
methods.description: Intercepts update requests for dashboards.

methods.name: interceptExploreUpdate
methods.description: Intercepts update requests for charts.

methods.name: interceptPost
methods.description: Intercepts POST requests to create dashboards.

methods.name: interceptLog
methods.description: Intercepts log event requests.

methods.name: interceptFav
methods.description: Intercepts requests to add dashboards to favorites.

methods.name: interceptUnfav
methods.description: Intercepts requests to remove dashboards from favorites.

methods.name: interceptDataset
methods.description: Intercepts dataset fetch requests.

methods.name: interceptCharts
methods.description: Intercepts requests to fetch charts of a dashboard.

methods.name: interceptDatasets
methods.description: Intercepts requests to fetch datasets of a dashboard.

methods.name: interceptFilterState
methods.description: Intercepts requests to save filter state.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets a filter value in the dashboard filter UI.

methods.name: expandFilterOnLeftPanel
methods.description: Expands the native filter panel on the dashboard.

methods.name: collapseFilterOnLeftPanel
methods.description: Collapses the native filter panel on the dashboard.

methods.name: enterNativeFilterEditModal
methods.description: Opens the native filter edit modal from the dashboard.

methods.name: clickOnAddFilterInModal
methods.description: Clicks to add a new filter in the native filter modal.

methods.name: fillNativeFilterForm
methods.description: Fills the native filter form with specified parameters.

methods.name: getNativeFilterPlaceholderWithIndex
methods.description: Gets the placeholder element for a native filter input by index.

methods.name: applyNativeFilterValueWithIndex
methods.description: Applies a value to a native filter input by index.

methods.name: addParentFilterWithValue
methods.description: Sets a parent filter dependency with a specific value.

methods.name: saveNativeFilterSettings
methods.description: Saves the current native filter settings and waits for charts to load.

methods.name: cancelNativeFilterSettings
methods.description: Cancels and discards changes in native filter settings.

methods.name: validateFilterNameOnDashboard
methods.description: Validates that a filter name appears correctly on the dashboard.

methods.name: validateFilterContentOnDashboard
methods.description: Validates that filter content appears correctly on the dashboard.

methods.name: deleteNativeFilter
methods.description: Deletes a native filter from the dashboard.

methods.name: undoDeleteNativeFilter
methods.description: Undoes the deletion of a native filter.

methods.name: checkNativeFilterTooltip
methods.description: Checks the tooltip content of a native filter by index.

methods.name: applyAdvancedTimeRangeFilterOnDashboard
methods.description: Applies an advanced time range filter with optional start and end ranges.

methods.name: inputNativeFilterDefaultValue
methods.description: Inputs a default value into a native filter setting.

methods.name: addCountryNameFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter for the 'Country name' column.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Opens a specific tab in the dashboard component.

methods.name: openTopLevelTab
methods.description: Opens a top-level tab by name.
